description: This file contains definitions for a HookJob struct and a HookExecutor actor, which manages executing external hook commands with certain configurations, including handling cooldowns, environment variables, and process management.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands based on configuration, respecting cooldowns, environment setup, and process termination.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the hook should run based on cooldown period.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the hook command asynchronously, setting up environment variables and handling process lifecycle with a timeout.
